assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent botanical UI asset for a quiet Chinese/French moonlit paper settings drawer. Primary request: ONE extremely slender vertical meandering vine, graceful continuous S curves descending, fine pale sage and blue-grey leaves, tiny sparse tendrils, fine natural botanical watercolor texture with translucent edges and delicate silver veins. No flowers (flowers will be separate). No moon, no butterfly, no frame, no text, no backdrop, no glow, no ground shadow. Tall portrait 1:3 composition with the complete vine fitting comfortably and a small transparent safety margin; the vine is airy and narrow rather than a dense bush, with many open gaps. Cool muted sage and slate-blue, soft right-upper moonlight. True transparent alpha PNG. High-resolution 768 by 2304 pixels if possible, intended as 3x asset, not a screenshot.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent ornament for quiet moonlit botanical UI. Primary request: ONE delicate pale silver-white crescent moon with five very fine dangling pearl chains and TWO wispy blush-pink silk tassels at different heights, each long and fine. Some minuscule pearlescent bead highlights, translucent porcelain crescent, subtle botanical engraving, no flowers. Whole ornament is airy, elegant French antique jewelry rendered in fine watercolor-realistic illustration, not cartoon, not shiny gold. Cool moonlight from upper right. Tall portrait canvas, full ornament visible with transparent safety margin, no frame, no text, no background, no ambient halo or ground shadow. True transparent alpha PNG. High resolution 768 by 1536 pixels if possible for 3x use.
